name: Sahaja Yamalapalli
bio:
Career Overview: Sahaja Yamalapalli is an emerging Indian tennis player making strides on the ITF circuit and aiming for WTA success.

Playing Style: Known for her steady baseline play and defensive skills, she combines consistency with occasional aggressive shot-making.

Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #258 (October 14, 2024)
Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: #424 (August 5, 2024)

Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to qualify for a Grand Slam main draw; has competed in ITF events to build her ranking.

Notable Achievements:
  • Won 2 ITF singles titles, including the $25K Gurugram event in 2024, and 1 ITF doubles title.
  • Overtook Ankita Raina as India's No. 1 women's singles player in 2024.
  • Biggest Singles Win: Defeated higher-ranked players during her 2024 ITF title runs, showcasing her growing prowess.

Other Highlights:
  • A product of the Indian tennis system, Sahaja has shown rapid improvement, climbing over 100 ranking spots in 2024 alone.
  • Trains diligently to compete on the global stage.

Sahaja is a rising star in Indian tennis, poised to carry forward the legacy of women's tennis in the country.
